subject: Change size of points in legend

messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Change size of points in legend
parts:
Hi,

i have a plot with geom_jitter() with two colors. the legend shows me
the two dots with the same size they are in the plot.
is there a way to change the size of the dots in the legend?

opts(legend.key.size = unit(c(1.8,1.8),"lines"))

changes the legend size but not the dots, they don't seem to resize.
i found an answer by koshke [
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/cab16e0dda13cac3/d6789acab3971b5c?lnk=raot&fwc=1
] suggesting to use this:

grid.gedit(size=unit(5, "mm"), "key.points", grep=T)

but when i add it to my code i get the following exception:

Fehler in editDLfromGPath(gPath, specs, strict, grep, global,
redraw) : 'gPath' (key.points) not found

Thanks in advance,
Thomas

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Change size of points in legend
parts:
Hi

ggsave and grid.edit() cannot work together.

try:

pdf(file="foo.pdf",height=9.5,width=7.4)
print(p)
grid.gedit(...)
dev.off()
